messages.author: 166e40180306ffff
messages.subject: justification of key labels
parts:
Hi

I noticed that with the newest version of ggplot2 key labels are now
right justified. See for example:
ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill=cut)) + geom_bar()

Is this a bug or has it been changed intentionally? I liked the
default left justification of previous versions much better.

Regards,
Erich

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: justification of key labels
parts:
Hi Erich,

It's a bug. You can track my progress on fixing it at
http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/#issue/59

Hadley
